d: We are seven days away from the midterm elections and there are shenanigans afoot, Trump gave an update on the war he said was over on day one - eight months ago, government corruption is the number one issue for Americans going into the election, Trump complimented Nicki Minaj’s “ass" during a rally in Michigan, President Obama was stumping in Detroit for Abdul El-Sayed, the number of people committing voter fraud is almost zero, Pete Hegseth’s staff broke a globe that had been used by Eisenhower during World War II, and Trump is trying to rename everything.
